consequence.statement: The cilium-docker-plugin will be removed in v1.18; environments currently using it should plan for migration to alternative Docker integration methods.

original.statement: The cilium-docker-plugin component has been deprecated and is planned for removal in v1.18.

decision.reason: [ev-c082dfefeb1b] lists the cilium-docker-plugin under "Deprecated Options" and says it "has been deprecated and is planned to be removed in v1.18". So in 1.17 it still works and is only scheduled to be removed later. That fits the deprecation kind, which means review is required, not mandatory work. The statement's mention of "alternative Docker integration methods" is only planning advice; the evidence names no replacement, but the phrase does not change the kind or the class.
